## Summary of Changes

A concise description of the changes introduced by this pull request.

## Related Issues

Fixes / Closes #

## Type of Change

- [ ] `feat`: New feature or surface capability
- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation updates
- [ ] `refactor`: Refactoring without behavior changes
- [ ] `test`: Added or updated unit/integration tests
- [ ] `chore`: Tooling, dependencies, or maintenance

## Presubmit Verification

Please confirm that all presubmit checks pass before requesting review:

- [ ] `cargo test --lib -q` passed clean
- [ ] `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed with zero warnings
- [ ] `cargo run -q -- fmt` executed to format code
- [ ] Commit message matches Conventional Commits format: `<type>(<scope>): <description> (Fixes #<issue>)`

## Additional Notes for Reviewers

Any specific areas of focus, architecture decisions, or context reviewers should be aware of.
